description:
Connect Movena to ChatGPT to understand gym booking performance or review your own approved training information.

Gym owners can review weekly booking health and daily booking trends across the business locations they select, including capacity, occupancy, fill rates and waitlists. Coaches receive operational summaries only for locations and sessions they are currently authorised to access. Reports contain business totals and approved business location names; they never disclose member names, contact details, notes, attendance records or other member personal information.

Eligible members can separately choose whether to share My training and My session health. Each category is off by default, independently consented and independently withdrawable in Movena. Operator authority never substitutes for member consent. My training includes workout results from the last 30 days and non-heart-rate personal records with no date cutoff. When a result is linked to an exercise in Movena’s catalogue, Movena includes the catalogue exercise name and available movement classifications. Names assigned to gym-created exercises are never shared.

My session health may include session duration, time in five heart-rate zones, intensity, training load, heart-rate coverage and data-quality indicators from the last 30 days. Movena excludes raw heart-rate readings, average and peak heart rate, calories, sleep, daily-health data, date of birth, coach notes, arbitrary member- or gym-authored text, internal identifiers and other members’ information.

Movena provides read-only informational summaries. It cannot change bookings, memberships, payments, messages or training records, and it does not provide diagnosis, treatment or medical clearance. Access uses Movena sign-in and explicit approval, expires after one hour and cannot be refreshed. Users can withdraw either member category or disconnect the assistant from Movena.
